messages:
Julia: Heads-up: FinServe wants a single enterprise commit to cover us-east + eu-west. Requirements: p99 chat <250ms, reserve GPUs + autoscale plan, and compliance checklist. Can we do a quick sanity on pooled vs per-region reserves and a cost ballpark?
Mike: Quick answer: reserved GPUs are regional. You can approximate pooling with per-region reserves + global routing + warm standby, but expect extra latency on failover.
Anika: We need their RPS and token distribution to size properly. If not available, use heuristic: reserved = steady 80th pct RPS * GPU capacity.
Julia: They gave rough: peak 5k RPS, avg 80 tokens/req, model throughput ~8 tok/sec per GPU (quantized). They proposed 40 GPUs.
Mike: If split 60/40 (us-east/eu-west) + aggressive KV/prefix caching + quantization, 40 could work. Add 20% headroom and prewarm slots.
Anika: Recommend two model variants: quant-v1 for normal traffic, fp16 for fallbacks. Route by latency/cost. Cuts reserved by ~25% in many cases.
Raj: Ops constraints: reserved pools are per-region/AZ. For cross-region fallback we need KV replication and warm standby — expect 5-10% perf hit on failover.
Tina: Compliance note: FinServe requires CMK in KMS and 30-day audit retention on inputs/outputs. Supported in Dedicated/Private; hosted needs configuration.
Evan: Pricing quick sketch: Option A = 40 reserved GPUs (24 US /16 EU) ~ $128k/mo draft; Option B = hybrid 28 reserved + burst credits -> ~25% lower commit but higher overage. I'll prepare formal quote.
Julia: Can someone paste a sample autoscale config for the POC (prewarm + burst rules)?
Mike: Sample (informal):
```json
{
  "policy": "priority",
  "reserved": [{"region": "us-east", "gpus": 24}, {"region": "eu-west", "gpus": 16}],
  "burst": {"max_gpus": 60, "burst_credits": 20000},
  "prewarm": {"enabled": true, "window": "20m", "slots": 8},
  "cooldown_s": 30,
  "fallback_model": "quant-v1"
}
```
Mike: Ops tips: small scheduled prewarm, cooldown ~30s for chat, prefer cache hits before scaling.
Anika: For POC we should run 48h profiling with traces (token lengths, p50/p95/p99) to recommend final reserved numbers and warm-up plan.
Julia: I'll request 24h traffic sample + security form.
Tina: Once I get their security answers I'll validate CMK + retention; will flag blockers within 48h.
capacity-bot: Draft quote created: commit-40gpus-hybrid-estimate_v1 — est $128,400/mo (internal).
Evan: I'll assemble two-option PDF with POC runbook and unit economics for quant vs fp16.
Julia: Next steps: 1) FinServe provide 24h trace + security form, 2) we run 48h profiling, 3) finalize reserved/autoscale plan and quote.
Raj: I'll draft the KV replication and cross-region warm standby runbook.
Anika: I'll create the token-distribution script and POC checklist.
Tina: Will review security answers and reply within 48h.
Julia: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
